name: Nathan Seymour
source:
An effeminate hero with flame abilities, equipped with a highly maneuverable race car. He displays an advanced level of control over his abilities, able to shape his flames into many elaborate shapes and sizes with varying levels of intensity. He is also the owner of his sponsor company, Helios Energy.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Tiger_%26_Bunny_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
